response.what_it_is: LED rope light on a plastic spool/drum
hidden_risks: Exact total length of the rope light in meters
Whether the power cord and rectifier are included
Presence of any factory defects or dead sections
response.best_proof: A photo showing the packaging label with length specifications and included accessories
response.failure_mode: Mistaking the item for general electrical wire or failing to account for unspecified length and missing power connectors.
